services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Pass Creek Regional Park is a 36.1 hectare park located across the Columbia River and opposite the City of Castlegar. It is located at Park Side Road in Robson. Facilities in the park include a swimming pond, beach, picnic areas, 30 camping sites, children’s playground, ball field, soccer/field hockey field, and nature trails. A riding ring and equestrian facilities are located at the adjacent Pass Creek Exhibition Grounds. Pass Creek Campground is scheduled to open on May 1, 2026.
